limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

ECONOMIC_GROWTH.rationale: Authoritative GDP/labor data: Japan Q3 contraction, UK 0.7% growth, Germany GDP complicating recession calls, Canadian youth unemployment, Norway record unemployment, Bangladesh overstated GDP, US jobs report, Qatar Q3 GDP. Excluded stale/dated 2020–2023 items and listicles.

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Material supply/demand and policy state changes: supply surplus pressuring prices, UAE exiting OPEC, Eni-Libya gas deal, Jackdaw field startup, Russia targeting Ukraine energy hubs, Exxon-Venezuela deal, Australian gas reservation vote, Japan GDP contraction on high oil. Excluded listicles, local gas prices, stock-picking.

FINANCIAL_STRESS.rationale: Only five distinct material candidates exist (AI credit stress via CoreWeave bond yield, Heartland-TSB takeover delay on liquidity review, imminent default deadline, Bangladesh default-loan concentration, SNAP-cut strain on food banks); returned all per instruction. Excluded games, credit-market puffery, sports.

HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Authoritative health-policy changes: states ending coverage under Medicaid cuts, CMS extension of work-rule grace period, Medicare physician pay cut, FDA rejecting Summit's lung-cancer drug, CGuard stent approval, German drug-price hikes, Medicare Advantage plan exits, Texas Medicaid backlog/Nebraska work rules. Excluded opinion, stock-picking.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Distinct, verified geopolitical state changes with global transmission (Iran-US/Gulf escalation, Russia-Ukraine strikes, EU/UK sanctions on Russia, Houthi strikes, Israel-Hamas killing, Yemen Houthi advances, DRC/Kenya terror attacks). Excluded local crime, sports, promotional and unrelated items.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Verified inflation/rate state changes with global transmission: hot US CPI raising half-point hike risk, ECB/Bank of England hike signals, Israel inflation falling to 5-yr low, UK inflation easing, Japan contraction on inflation, energy-shock inflation, RBNZ policy criticism, and India/US inflation triggers. Excluded op-eds and stock-picking.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Verified shocks with transmission: Hurricane Italia Florida/Georgia storm-surge threat, Guatemala state of emergency after lawmaker killing, Cabo Verde re-election, Israel coalition politics/Netanyahu office probe, Indonesia haze apology, Norway flood aid to Pakistan, Kenya/Vancouver Island flood disruptions, Maui wildfire report. Excluded local fires, historical and opinion items.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Distinct market/mining state changes: gold edging on rate signals, gold-price predictions/1.6% climb on inflation relief, gold-silver weekly decline, India gold-mining ramp-up to cut imports, silver-use reduction in solar, KSM copper-gold high-grade zone, India gold-import easing trade deficit, Titan shifting from gold-price gains. Excluded sports/awards/'gold' metaphor.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Material chip/AI state changes: Lutnick pushing to weaken chip rules (conflict of interest), QTS cutting AI data-center debt sale on pricing pushback, Alibaba listing T-Head, SK Hynix supplier spend, Nvidia China access doubts after Huang exit, tighter chip export control push, SK Telecom-Hyosung AI data centers, Bharat Semi funding. Excluded poker, sports, listicles.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Authoritative trade-policy changes: Supreme Court rejecting global tariffs, Canada 100% EV tariffs, US-China tariff-cut talks, India-US comparative advantage, EU solar tariffs, Indonesia-Canada CEPA, Brazil diversifying from US tariffs, tighter chip export controls. Excluded opinion, health tariffs, embargoes.
